claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract conformance only. No diagnostic accuracy, physical machinery health, safety, seaworthiness, certification, maintenance authorization or permission to operate is established.

cases.description: Nominal propulsion has a current sensor observation.
Main engine derating is supported by two separate declared signal dependencies.
Shaft and engine channels share one controller and cannot count as two dependency groups.
Steering command and rudder feedback disagree across declared input groups.
A native generator start-failure alarm is current.
Switchboard bus undervoltage is observed on a current channel.
Battery management reports a current unavailable state.
Cooling channels conflict and neither conflicted sample is admitted.
A current model residual is retained as model-derived evidence, not a direct sensor.
Steering has valid measured feedback and no active fault hypothesis.
A stale fuel-system observation cannot support a current restriction decision.
A wrong-unit pressure observation is excluded from decision evidence.
An observation from an older installed configuration is excluded.
An expired-calibration vibration channel cannot establish current health.
An unauthenticated remote diagnostic is not admitted.
Simulator-only state is never admitted as deployment evidence.
High bilge level and pump unavailability are both current observations.
Flood ingress is supported by current level and detector channels.
Fire detection has current native alarm evidence.
Suppression availability remains unknown despite an otherwise current observation.
Ballast pump failure has current alarm evidence.
HVAC failure affects a declared electronics-cooling capability.
Three current alarms share one power dependency; they are not three independent sources.
Three current signals have distinct declared dependency groups and no fault hypothesis.
A maintenance record is admitted as supporting evidence but is not direct telemetry.
An operator report remains a report and cannot be promoted into a measured channel.
A model output outside its declared domain remains unknown.
Multiple observations share a clock dependency and cannot establish independent timing.
Missing lineage excludes an otherwise plausible machinery signal.
A valid native equipment state is available with no active fault hypothesis.
A repair record exists but inspection and proof-test evidence are incomplete.
Technical recovery records exist but scoped authorization is absent.
Repair evidence exists but the installed configuration has not been reconciled.
The only post-repair test observation is stale.
A current post-repair observation still carries an unresolved active fault hypothesis.
Repair, inspection, proof test, authorization and configuration reconciliation are present for independent review.
